energyCorrection.description: Correction of the energy estimate accepted from the weight trend: estimate × factor, accepted on day

askDays.description: Weekdays (1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday) to ask about each thing on when a day lacks it; unset = every day, [] = never

pieces.description: Logged as a count of pieces: how many (grams is what counts)

grams.description: Grams eaten of the batch's cooked weight; sets the nutrients instead of portions

ingredients.description: This serving's ingredients when it differed from the pot, in grams for the whole pot

nutrients.description: Amounts by BLS component code, in BLS units (e.g. {"VITC": 12.5} mg)

favouriteActivities.description: Activities pinned in the activity sheet: what, usual minutes and effort, Compendium row, outside, sun skin; no time

potId.description: The named pot (settings.pots) this recipe was last cooked in

recipeIngredients.description: The recipe's ingredients when this pot was made differently (recipe.ingredients is what went in)

cookedGrams.description: Weight of the cooked food without the pot, in grams

ingredients.description: This serving's ingredients when it differed from the pot, in grams for the whole pot

usdaType.description: USDA only: the FoodData Central data type

per100.description: Values per 100 g (per 100 ml if perMl) by BLS component code, in BLS units: label values, or USDA database values for USDA generic foods. A nutrient without a value is absent.

match.description: BLS food that supplies the nutrients the source lacks

auto.description: Picked by the app, not checked by the user yet

labelOnly.description: The user chose no similar food: only the values from the source count

items.description: A food from an online database, as fetched: a packaged product from Open Food Facts (ODbL) or a food from USDA FoodData Central (public domain)

private.description: Kept from the AI unless the user includes private entries

items.description: One sleep: fell asleep (start) and woke up (end, missing while asleep), epoch ms; day is the local day it ended

compendium.description: Code of the 2024 Adult Compendium of Physical Activities row it counts as; missing: the row for its kind and intensity

items.description: One activity: what, when (epoch ms), how long, roughly how hard, outside or not; sunSkin when it counts toward the vitamin D sun estimate
Plain water drunk: when (epoch ms) and how much (ml); drinks with nutrients are food log entries

One line on the shopping list: what, how much (grams and/or a typed amount), the shop section, the recipes it is for; ticked off (checkedAt) or cleared after shopping (clearedAt, kept as suggestions), epoch ms

Something at home: what, the food it is, where it is kept, how much there was at `since` (pieces, grams, or another amount as typed; what is left is worked out from the log and cooked batches from then on), and whether the user marked it running low or used up; epoch ms

A ketone measurement: when (epoch ms), how (blood: β-hydroxybutyrate in mmol/L from a finger-prick meter; breath: acetone in ppm, device-specific; urine: acetoacetate in mmol/L as the strip reads) and the value in that unit

kind.description: do: done or not; avoid: had some or none; minutes: minutes of activity a day, read from the activity log

oneOf.description: Tracked without a target (do and minutes habits): never due, no run

goal.description: When it is due; for an avoid habit a maximum (never, never on these days, at most n days a week)

minutes.description: Minutes habits: the day's total that counts as kept; missing with no target (any minutes count)

activities.description: Activities that count toward a minutes habit; empty or missing = any

quick.description: Minutes habits with "One tap logs it": the activity a tap on its Home card logs, ending at the tap

sun.description: When outside: counts toward the vitamin D sun estimate

items.description: A habit to do or avoid, or minutes of activity, with its goal

did.description: It happened: done (do habit) or had some (avoid habit)

items.description: One answer for a habit on one day; a day without one is open, not "no"

piece.description: The weight of one piece of this food (at most one per food), so amounts can be given as a count

items.description: Portion sizes the user saved for one food ("My bowl", 60 g), by the food code they were saved under

per100g.description: Amounts by BLS component code, in BLS units (e.g. {"VITC": 12.5} mg)
